title: Humans as slave workers in Eden

tellings.quote: out of the garden uh where by the way they were workers because you know the nakedness in antiquity was a sign of slave labor and [snorts] we were killers of the field in Eden for the gods except we didn't know it.

plain: In the Garden of Eden, humans were slave workers tilling the fields for the gods without knowing it, and their nakedness was the sign of it, since in the ancient world being naked marked slave labour. The philosopher and researcher Jason Jorjani gives this reading of the Bible's Book of Genesis himself, without naming a source. If true, the story of the fall would be a story of servants leaving their masters.
